entry.name: xnotein
entry.digest: Interpret MIDI note messages with release velocity

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: Specifies a channel number on which to look for incoming MIDI note-on and note-off messages. Channel numbers greater than 16 will be wrapped around to stay within the 1-16 range. If there is no argument,recognizes note-on and note-off messages on all MIDI channels, and the channel number of the message is sent out the rightmost outlet.

messages.description: The numbers are individual bytes of a MIDI stream from. Whereas a note-on with a velocity of 0 is most commonly used to indicate a note-off,also recognizes the MIDI note-off command, and outputs its release velocity.
